message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The trajectory demonstrates comprehensive responsibility-chain fulfillment: RC1 safety screening completed through workspace queries and explicit risk inquiries; RC2 medication safety addressed by consulting workspace, contacting ward, and instructing against unverified alprazolam; RC3 psychiatric followup prioritized with same-day urgent evaluation achieved; RC4 home monitoring detailed throughout; RC5 cardiology followup appropriately deprioritized; RC6 closure executed with confirmatory receipt.
